pr_title: bluetooth: tester: gap: Add support for extended advertising
pr_body:
Needed for LE Audio tests.

Fixes #60494

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: No BLE ext adv btp commands support in bt_tester app
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
we are in enabling the TMAP pts test cases with auto-pts
but for the TMAP device discovery test suite, it requires to set the different TMAP Role characteristic in extended advertising.
![image](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/3600912/8a61474b-887f-4520-a3d3-12e3b6a935a3)

but we could not find the ext_adv btp commands in bt_tester, 
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/tests/bluetooth/tester/src/btp_gap.c

**Describe the solution you'd like**
add some btp commands and events in bt_tester app for the ext_adv apis.
![image](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/3600912/44b0051b-41ad-4644-b611-d475e5964edf)
comments: I already have a patch for ext adv, because I needed it for BAP tests for unicast server. I'll post a PR soon.

review_comments: Why is one `uint8_t` and the other `uint32_t`? Shouldn't these be similarly typed?

Those are not equivalent, the names can be misleading. Those are separate bit fields. This command was defined in BTP like this:
https://github.com/auto-pts/auto-pts/blob/36f38273cae21dbd57e2583ff670188e13ee390a/doc/btp_gap.txt#L499-L511
and the Current_Settings is defined here:
https://github.com/auto-pts/auto-pts/blob/36f38273cae21dbd57e2583ff670188e13ee390a/doc/btp_gap.txt#L49C3-L69C27
